notes.title: Gear Stalker: Quick Pitch
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37828534/24e7ad07158732f45c86475886094c2c244aad78.jpg

This game takes inspiration from several great games including Monster Hunter, Horizon Zero Dawn, Half-Life Alyx and the roguelike genre. 

The demo itself is an early playable concept missing most of the features planned for the final game which will include:


 A full single-player campaign
 Destructible buildings
 Multiple modular boss mechs
 Non-hostile mechs
 Merchants
 Crafting
 Procedural map and level generation
 Background story elements to piece together


In the final game you will travel the wastelands scavenging from the ruins of civilisation while you fight giant mechs left over from a long forgotten war.

Combat with boss mechs will last several minutes so preparation for the encounter will be as important as the combat itself. Study the behaviours and weaknesses of your target, prepare traps and kill zones, craft tools and equipment necessary to survive the encounter.
